title: Group splitting against the real specialist incumbent (train-score children + fusion)
question: With split children fit on the group's TRAIN rows and the real cached specialist as the incumbent, does the transactional split recover structure without losing accuracy?

registration_notes.N101.1: Registered AFTER M149's sealed negative (held-out incumbent re-fit weakened the baseline). This cell does NOT re-adjudicate M149; it re-tests on the train-score axis (epistemic rule 2) using the M143b train-score cache.
registration_notes.N101.2: Per group (domain): proposal = seeded 2-means on the domain's 2415-dim train score vectors -> children X, Y; child ridges fit on their cluster's train rows; fusion = stacking over [X_scores, Y_scores] with the penalty ladder {1,10,100,1000,10000} selected on a seeded 80/20 slice of the group's train rows; evaluated on the group's TEST rows.
registration_notes.N101.3: Incumbent = the REAL cached specialist's predictions on the group's test rows (v16/m143/scores.npz, never recomputed). Control = a seeded random split with the identical recipe.
registration_notes.N101.4: Gate: a domain PASSES iff fused(2-means) >= incumbent + 0.005 AND fused(2-means) >= fused(random) on its test rows. Fired iff ZERO domains pass. Row floor: clusters below the floor or degenerate are SKIPPED, not failed.
registration_notes.N101.5: The train-domain and test-domain assignments come from the sealed corpus loader (exact), never from a surrogate.

gate.registered: domain passes iff fused(2-means) >= incumbent + 0.005 AND fused(2-means) >= fused(random) on its test rows; fired iff ZERO domains pass.
gate.consequence_fired: even with train-row children and the real incumbent, the split operation has no measured room; splitting stays registered but unproven on this corpus.
gate.consequence_passed: with train-row children and the real incumbent, split-and-rebuild beats the incumbent on at least one domain: the registry split is a measured, promotable operation.
